title: Desktop App
summary: Interfere is now available as a desktop app for macOS and Windows, with native notifications for new problems.
body_markdown:
We’ve built the desktop app, so Interfere can live in its own window and in your dock instead of another browser tab.


Once you turn on notifications, you’ll know the moment a new high-priority problem opens or an investigation needs your input.


Available now for macOS and Windows at[interfere.com/download](https://interfere.com/download) .
